project_description: Comprehensive R package (uknpm) implementing UK dietary and food healthiness assessment models: UK Nutrient Profile Model (NPM 2004/2005 & 2018), Multiple Traffic Light Labelling (MTL), and UK Calorie, Salt, and Sugar Reduction Programme targets and SDIL levy thresholds
